$comment: GitHub Actions workflows that exist in the repository but that GitHub never reads,
because Actions only registers .github/workflows/ at the repository root. Read by
scripts/check-workflow-locations.mjs, which fails on a new one and on a row here that
The one row below is recorded, not accepted. It is an off-site backup of every
uploaded document that has never run, and moving it is one `git mv` — but it would
start running on a schedule the moment it moved, and whether its secrets exist is a
question for whoever owns the deploy path, not for a CI branch. Recording it is what
makes the check an error for everything else.

known.why: The off-site copy of the document originals, on a daily and a weekly cron. It sits under the workspace directory rather than the repository root, so Actions has never registered it: the workflows API lists CI and pages-build-deployment and nothing else, and this file has executed zero times. Its own header says the failure mode it guards against is 'nobody noticed it stopped' — it never started, and a dead-man's switch that was never wound cannot fire. Fixing it is `git mv photographic/.github/workflows/document-archive.yml .github/workflows/`, after confirming BACKUP_HEARTBEAT_URL and the bucket credentials are set, because the move is what makes it begin running. Owned by the deploy path; delete this row when it moves.
